gemini.title: Education County
gemini.abstract: Education County is an authoritative dataset published by Central Statistics Office Ireland. It contains records relating to education county.
gemini.lineage: Published by Central Statistics Office Ireland as open statistics and census data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
